notes.title: There… something trembles. Something calls again.
notes.content:
[p]Where the silence of the corridors is broken by the echo of footsteps, the [i]Prologue[/i] keeps transforming.[/p][p]Today’s update brings not only smoother gameplay and higher FPS, but also new refinements in visuals and sound.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 What’s new in this update[/h2][p][b]Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]significantly improved performance in VR,[/p][/*][*][p]resolved frequent stuttering issues,[/p][/*][*][p]enhanced overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 It’s not the summit yet – but a big step forward.[/p][p][b]Graphics & Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]new visual effects and artistic tweaks,[/p][/*][*][p]additional sound elements to enrich the atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💬 The role of the Prologue[/h2][p]From the very beginning, [i]The Riese Project – Prologue[/i] has been a dialogue with players.
The full version of the game remains in the shadows – which is why here you have a direct impact on the shape of the entire project.
This is where we test solutions, listen to feedback, and implement changes.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌌 The personal side of this project[/h2][p][i]The Riese Project[/i] was born within a small team. Its first chapter, shared with you on Steam, became [i]The Riese Project – Prologue[/i].
As time passed, I was left alone – but I continue carrying what we started.[/p][p]It’s a heavy subject, shrouded in silence – and not everyone wanted to stay with it.
I was warned that those who listen to this place for too long may vanish into its darkness.
Maybe so… but I will not stop.[/p][p]This story grows from real undergrounds – unfinished tunnels carved into the mountains, filled with concrete, rust, and silence.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="UavjS96sXxU;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p]This is my journey – and you are part of it.
Today, [i]The Riese Project – Prologue[/i] is already present on over [b]40,000 player accounts[/b].
It’s a sign that this story is alive – and that I’m not creating it in a void.
Your voices truly shape the direction of the full version of [i]The Riese Project[/i].[/p][hr][/hr][p]🙏 Thank you – and I wish you smooth gameplay at full FPS.[/p][p][b]Sebastian (Masashige)[/b]
[i]Real Invented Studio[/i]
One Man Army[/p]

notes.title: The Riese Project Prologue for Free!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Our game is about uncovering mysteries. For our team, these discoveries are multi-dimensional. We've just discovered that "free" is a great price! :) :) :)

Yes, yes - many of you knew this already, but well, we have our flaws, and some obvious things take a while to sink in. Anyway, better late than later, and:

We have great news for you! We've decided that The Riese Project Prologue will be available for free. We want more people to join our mysterious adventure and share their feedback to help us work on the full version.

From the beginning, we treated the prologue as an introduction to the full version and a way to communicate with you. We regularly add new updates that show what we're working on. The prologue is our little dialogue between us and you, the players, and we want as many people as possible to participate.

Dear Player - if you bought the game earlier, you are a superhero! Without you, we wouldn't be here. We plan to prepare special bonuses for you as a thank you (and no, they won't just be virtual hugs, although those are also valuable!). We'll share more details soon.

The change to free status will happen soon, pending approval from Steam. Keep an eye out, because free fun is coming!

Add The Riese Project Prologue to your wishlist on Steam so you don't miss any updates and news!

Thank you for your support, smiles, and feedback!

Real Invented Studio Team

notes.title: New Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Another Prologue update marks another step in our journey towards the full game release. In addition to immersing you in the history of the Riese complex, we're excited to showcase our progress in developing the full version of The Riese Project.

This update introduces controller support for the FPP mode, a feature frequently requested by you. We'd love to hear your feedback - do the mapped buttons meet your expectations, or do you have other suggestions? Currently, we've focused on Xbox controller compatibility, but we believe the PlayStation controller will also work seamlessly.

We regularly add new graphics and audio elements to enhance your experience in both FPP and VR modes.

Wishing you happy gaming! 🎮

Real Invented Studio Team

notes.title: New Price! Dive into the world of The Riese Project Prologue for less!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are  trying to reach the widest possible audience with the Riese Project. The prologue not only serves as an introduction to our game but also acts as a progress indicator in our work towards the full version. The invaluable feedback from players directs our actions and inspires us to further improvements. In response to your suggestions, we have introduced the FPP mode and continue to update the game, adding new elements that will also be part of the final version. Additionally, in response to player feedback, we have decided to lower the price of the prologue so that even more people can experience our game and participate in its development process. Like most of you, we believe that "free" is the best price 🙂 . Unfortunately, as a small studio, we need to finance our work in some way so that its effects bring satisfaction to you and enable our team to focus on its quality 100%. We hope that this step we are taking will be perceived by you as another expression of our respect for the community of people who love games as much as we do.

Be with us - support independent creators
The Riese Project.

notes.title: New Game Mode: First Person Perspective (FPP) Added! 🎮
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to announce the long-awaited update to "The Riese Project Prologue"! 🎉

We introduce the FPP mode! Now both VR players and fans of traditional gameplay can explore the secrets of the Riese complex in full glory. 🌟

The new FPP mode opens up completely new perspectives for exploration and discovery, while preserving all the unique aspects that VR players love. 🌐

With the introduction of this mode - as we regularly do since the game's release - we have added further improvements and fixes to provide you with even more satisfying experiences. We can't wait to hear your feedback, suggestions, and criticism, which help us determine the direction of our project's development! 📈

With the new update, we have decided to remove the Potato mode. The Prologue serves as an introduction and a reflection of our work on the full version of The Riese Project, also setting the direction we are heading, including in terms of hardware. We assess that such a mode will no longer be relevant by 2025. 🥔❌

Join us now and embark on an unforgettable journey through the world of The Riese Project Prologue, whether you prefer virtual reality or traditional gameplay. We wish you fantastic fun! 🎮🌈

Real Invented Studio Team 🚀

Dear Players,

We are thrilled to share exciting news about the latest update for The Riese Project - Prologue. Your support and patience have been invaluable, and working on this update has been a truly exhilarating challenge for us.

What's New:

Thank you for being with us on this incredible journey! We hope the new update brings even more joy to your gameplay. Your feedback is immensely important to us, so don't forget to share it - it's through your input that we shape our world!

From the heart,
Real Invented Studio
